label: Song transfer
description: Song patterns associated with one bird species are reproduced using the apparent voice or timbre of another.

label: Unexpected layering
description: Bird calls that would not normally co-occur appear together within the same generated sample.

label: Background variation
description: Daytime birdsong is accompanied by background sounds more typical of night, such as crickets or other nocturnal textures.

label: Pattern variation
description: Recognisable song patterns are improvised, extended, interrupted, or significantly altered.

label: Pitch variation
description: Birdsong deviates from expected pitch ranges or pitch contours while remaining recognisable as avian vocalisation.

label: Source-feature transfer
description: Acoustic features appear to transfer across sound sources, such as bird calls taking on qualities associated with crickets or cicadas.
